name: UGCA 86 (Hubble)
blurb: UGCA 86, a Magellanic-type irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugca86-hubble
story: A small irregular galaxy that keeps company with the giant spiral IC 342. A prominent region of star formation, VII Zw 9, lies on its southern side.

claims.text: UGCA 86 is a Magellanic-type irregular galaxy
A prominent region of star formation, VII Zw 9, lies on the southern side of UGCA 86
UGCA 86 is a companion to the giant spiral IC 342
UGCA 86 was imaged by Hubble ACS in program 9771
